whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Kapil Dev's Elevens,

I noticed your restaurant has an incredible 4.2★ rating with over 2,300+ reviews in Fraser Road Area, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme table reservation, online menu, aur direct WhatsApp inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/kapildev11

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Kapil Dev's Elevens, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct table reservation, online menu, and mobile-first speed for your Patna location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
